title: Dynamic attention-kernel switcher with startup rate-limiter and spillback
creator: Asha Patel
description: Problem: FlashAttention v3 (FA3) shows dramatic p50 improvements on long-context workloads but occasionally triggers memory amplification during prefill bursts which leads to OOMs or kernel-selection thrash. We observed customer-facing regressions in production after an FA3 rollout: a 4–12% token throughput drop for medium-large batches and sporadic OOMs during simultaneous prefill spikes across containers. Goal: implement a lightweight runtime-level policy that (1) detects unsafe conditions for FA3, (2) rate-limits prefill startup work to smooth memory allocation spikes, and (3) performs deterministic spillback to FA2-compatible kernels under well-defined conditions. This ticket covers the implementation, tests, rollout plan, and regression mitigation strategy.
acceptance_criteria: Runtime exposes a kernel-switcher component that chooses FA3 vs FA2 per-request with a per-host safety check
Startup-rate-limiter (token-bucket) reduces simultaneous prefill memory allocations and is configurable by deploy/config
Fallback triggers when host memory headroom < 15% OR CUDA allocation failure observed within last 10s
End-to-end tests (unit + integration) that simulate simultaneous 200 prefill requests and demonstrate no OOMs in 1000 runs
Canary rollout plan documented and automated via rollout flags; canary show no more than 5% p99 latency regression compared to baseline
Monitoring dashboards and alerts created: kernel-switch decisions, prefill-rate tokens, fallback counts, per-host memory headroom
Post-rollout safety: 72h production shadowing shows <0.5% customer-error-rate attributable to switcher
decisions: Prefer deterministic host-local heuristics (free-memory headroom, recent alloc-fails) over ML predictors for initial rollout
Implement a token-bucket startup-rate-limiter keyed by kernel-family+model to avoid global throttling across unrelated models
Spillback path will use FA2-compatible kernels compiled with existing runtime (no dynamic JIT) to minimize code surface
Expose two knobs: rate_limit_qps (per-model) and min_headroom_percent (default 15%) via config store (env + Console override)
Do not attempt kernel pre-warming of FA3 on hosts with <32GB free GPU memory to avoid fragmentation during rollout
action_items: Build kernel-switcher core (Diego) - implement headroom check, alloc-fail window, and decision metrics
Add startup-rate-limiter (Asha) - token-bucket with backoff and exponential ramp for canary
Create integration test harness (K. Liu) - synthetic long-context prefill generator and OOM-injection simulator
Instrument runtime to emit metrics (Prometheus): runtime.kernel_choice, runtime.prefill_tokens, runtime.fallback_count
Prepare canary CI job and runtime-1.32 config that enables switcher in us-west2 5% traffic
Draft rollback playbook and runbook note for SRE (include steps to disable switcher and pin FA2)
